resolutions.rationale: entry_spec_v5 explicitly requires 【頻度】〈n/10〉 and permits a consistently applied scale when no strict statistical basis exists. The four scores are internally ordered by broad encounter frequency and register, so replacing them with qualitative labels would violate the required format and is not warranted by this finding.
